name: dsh-skill-writing-plans
description: DeepSeek Harness skill plugin that adds the 'plan-first' skill: writes a structured implementation plan before coding, executes simple tasks inline, and offers an execution choice for complex work. The skill is named plan-first rather than writing-plans so it can coexist with the writing-plans skill that dsh-connect-trae exposes from a Trae skills directory.
author: linlin539
